facts.did: 告知 Gardenpath：Plumline 对实验室全体成员做 stack ranking 并公开，然后解雇排名垫底者
facts.anchor: Plumline has a stack ranking of all the lab members

facts.did: 在全实验室会议上宣讲“真正的天才”，并当场宣布开除 Turret 与 Lintel（“收拾东西”）
facts.anchor: Turret and Lintel, you can pack up.

facts.did: 反驳 Plumline 说她“每项测试都不及格”：称自己最近通过了第四次考试，考官还让她去报考第五次
facts.anchor: I recently passed the Fourth and my examiners asked

facts.did: 指控 Plumline 赶她走，是因为她一直抗议科学部参与云战争（用他们的数据造武器、在考前拿他们测试新毒物）
facts.anchor: I’ve been protesting the Science Division’s collaboration

facts.did: 吼出“GET OUT. NOW!”，话语裹着强效甲烷云与致短暂僵直恐惧的物质，把 Turret 逼出实验室
facts.anchor: lab on a powerful cloud of methane

facts.did: 在图书馆学习室提议先收集数据再动手：自己去问 Column，Wainscot 去 Stream 设施找 Plumline 的前学生，其余人分头打听，两次旅程后（Harvest 期间）原地再聚
facts.anchor: Wainscot will track down those former students

facts.did: 讲述 Plinth 的遭遇：Plumline 发表论文时把 Plinth 关于金属合金的整个数据库当作自己的成果放进附录，使 Plinth 再无可能被邀报考第五次，最终离开
facts.anchor: included Plinth’s entire database as an appendix

facts.did: 以与 Investigator Redoubt 合作为名，派 Gardenpath 回 Tentacle 取 director cells 样本，并称可让她参与合著文章
facts.anchor: I have a side project for you related to director cells

relations.relation: Wainscot 说 Gardenpath 是他在 Memory 交到的第一个真正的朋友（由不安的休战变成真正的友谊）
relations.anchor: you are the first true friend I’ve made at the Memory

relations.relation: Column 是 Gardenpath 的“前非正式导师”（Professor Column）
relations.anchor: my former informal adviser, Professor Column

relations.relation: Foundation 说 Plinth 是她的朋友（并要求大家说出 Plinth 的名字）
relations.anchor: Foundation was fuming. “Plinth was my friend.

relations.relation: Gardenpath 看出 Wainscot 与 Column 手臂探入彼此、散出愉悦激素，怀疑两人在调情
relations.anchor: Are they flirting? I really think they might be flirting.

relations.relation: Turret 问 Gardenpath 是不是也是移民（云族人与理性人的双重身份）
relations.anchor: you liked it. Are you an immigrant too?

numbers.fact: 距他们向 Murtis 表白（说爱他们）已过去两年
numbers.anchor: already been two years since they had told Murtis

numbers.fact: 另有八名 Plumline 实验室学生同他们一起下墙去图书馆
numbers.anchor: Before long, they had eight other Plumline Lab students

numbers.fact: Gardenpath 约定两次旅程后（Harvest 期间）在同一处会合
numbers.anchor: Let’s meet here in two journeys, during Harvest.

numbers.fact: Plumline 断言 Turret 毫无通过第五次考试的可能
numbers.anchor: You have no hope of passing the Fifth.
